entryBody: Paperclip will open {{serverName}} so you can choose a workspace and approve access.
resumeBody: Your connection is saved. Continue in {{serverName}} to approve access; its identity and agent access will stay the same.
preparingBody: Paperclip is creating a secure {{serverName}} connection.
redirectHostBody: Continue at {{authorizationHost}} to choose a workspace and approve access. Only approve access if you recognize that address.
redirectBody: Continue in {{serverName}} to choose a workspace and approve access.
startFailed: Paperclip couldn’t start secure sign-in. Try again.
subtitle: Secure MCP sign-in
openNewTab: Open sign-in in a new tab
callbackDenied: Authorization was cancelled or declined. Your saved connection was not changed.
githubRequired: GitHub access is required. Install Paperclip and grant at least one repository, then try again.
callbackIncomplete: Authorization did not complete. Your saved connection is still here, so you can try again.
popupBlocked: Paperclip couldn’t open the sign-in window. Open sign-in in a new tab to continue.
popupClosed: The sign-in window closed. If authorization did not finish, try again.
preserveFailed: Paperclip couldn’t preserve this sign-in while refreshing your account.
authorizationCancelled: Authorization was cancelled. You can try again.
authorizationIncomplete: Authorization did not complete. Try again when you’re ready.
githubWindowClosed: The sign-in window closed. Try again to finish connecting GitHub.
finishInWindow: Authorization did not complete. Finish setup in the sign-in window or try again.
confirmFailed: Could not confirm the connection. Try again.
authorizationExpired: Your authorization expired or was revoked. Reconnect to continue.
existingCheckFailed: Paperclip couldn’t check for an existing connection. Try again.
